content.query:
INSERT INTO EDS.D30_CUSTOMER (
USERNAME
,FULL_NAME
,CIF_ID
,ENROLLMENT_DATE
,Device
,Device_OS
,SCD_START_DATE
,SCD_END_DATE
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_Code
,Source_Code
,File_name
,insert_dttm
)
SELECT 
    USER_NAME USERNAME
    , FULL_NAME
    , CIF CIF_ID
    , ENROLLMENT_DATE
    , Device
    , Device_OS
    , CAST(ENROLLMENT_DATE AS DATE) SCD_START_DATE
    , '9999-12-31' SCD_END_DATE
    , 1 isActive
    , 1 isLatest
    , 'CBC01' BNK_Code
    , 'D30' Source_Code
    , 'D30_CUSTOMER_LIST' File_name
    , CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) insert_dttm
FROM EDS.D30_CUSTOMER_LIST
